{"schema": "CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, email TEXT,

    amount_twd INTEGER, paid_ts TEXT, payment_status TEXT)

    category TEXT, list_price_twd INTEGER, is_active INTEGER)

response: {"thought": "語意層要求期間依訂單成立時間（台北時間）歸屬，因此需要 join orders 取得 order_ts。先抽樣檢查時間欄位格式與 carrier='post' 的資料，確認時區與字串格式後再計算。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT s.shipment_id, s.carrier, s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts, o.order_ts FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id WHERE s.carrier = 'post' AND o.order_ts LIKE '2025%' LIMIT 10"}}
